body:
Starry SATB Choir is a diverse, welcoming, and vibrant community mixed choir based in Winnipeg, Manitoba. Our singers come from different age groups, cultural backgrounds, and musical experiences. Under professional musical direction, we bring people together through singing and use music as a way to connect, celebrate, and inspire.

The name “Starry” reflects our belief that every singer is a unique star. We believe that every voice has value, and when different voices come together, they create something greater—like a sky filled with stars.

Let every voice shine. Together, we sing like stars.
